purpose: answer-margin generalization check on four registry families outside the initial accuracy pilot

gates.baseline: At least 20 of 24 target-present gold margins > 0 and at least 20 of 24 matched target-removal margins drop by >=1 nat; base/swap reverses candidate identities
gates.variant: Only run one alpha and one MLP seed on 48 present-target candidates each after the baseline gate; report registry-clustered and per-layout contrasts descriptively

token_policy: exact GGUF chat prefix, no BOS, parse special, code plus <|im_end|>, 9 target IDs for every candidate
